messages:
Olga Petrov: getting more asks for "zero retention / no logging" for prompts+completions. Can we state a clear position for hosted vs private?

David Kim: For hosted: cant promise zero content at rest. Even if we turn sampling down, abuse/error paths may capture payloads.

Elliot Price: +1. For Private (VPC/on-prem) we can make a deployment where payloads never leave the customer boundary, but customer still has to choose their own logging settings.

Olga Petrov: ok. Ill keep the official line: hosted no; private can be configured. Linking the Confluence page so Support/AEs quote consistently: confluence:security-and-compliance/data-residency-and-retention/redwood-data-retention-and-logging-controls
